title: Design for trust and safety
summary: Consumer products can be misused for fraud, abuse or harmful content. Design protections in from the start.

beginner: List ways people could misuse the product or harm others.
Write clear rules about what is and is not allowed.
Give users easy ways to report problems and block others.
Decide how reports will be reviewed and how fast.
Check the laws that apply, including protections for children.
experienced: Build abuse detection and response into the product roadmap.

canDelegateTo.task: Advise on legal duties and policies

toolExamples.figma: Design report, block and appeal flows.
toolExamples.confluence: Keep content policies and the review process together.

pitfalls: Thinking about safety after an incident
